scope: Holistic full-feature code-quality audit after Tasks 1-7. Read-only. Focus on cross-component contracts invisible to per-task reviewers.
method: Read FINAL state of all 23 changed source/test files (dev vs main diff reconciled with decisions.md). Verified the four cross-component axes + architectural/scope invariants across the 11 code-reviewing dimensions.

validation_mirror_parity.detail: Each Decision 6 backend rule has an exact FunnelStepForm.vue mirror: mandatory non-blank text (FunnelService.requireKeyboardText:1347 ↔ keyboardTextError:631-635); 4096 HARD cap on RAW length (text.length() ↔ keyboardText.value.length, both un-trimmed); parse mode HTML/MarkdownV2/null (shared requireParseMode:1230 ↔ shared PARSE_MODES const :47, used by the keyboard select :1593); 1..10 rows (MAX_KEYBOARD_ROWS=10 ↔ KEYBOARD_MAX_ROWS=10); 1..4 buttons/row (MAX_KEYBOARD_ROW_BUTTONS=4 ↔ KEYBOARD_MAX_BUTTONS_PER_ROW=4); button non-blank ≤64 (MAX_KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TEXT=MAX_KEYWORD_LENGTH=64 ↔ KEYBOARD_BUTTON_TEXT_MAX=64); trimmed-duplicate block via Set, case NOT folded (validateSetKeyboard:1304-1323 ↔ keyboardHasDuplicate:646-657); CLEAR_KEYBOARD strict rejection of keyboardRows/isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard (validateClearKeyboard:1335-1343 ↔ onSubmit CLEAR case emits ONLY text+parseMode :982-988). All rejections route through invalidStep → 422 funnel_step_invalid (one code, varying message).

copyOf_completeness.detail: FunnelStep.copyOf (lines 144-152) carries all five new fields: keyboardText/keyboardParseMode/isPersistent/oneTimeKeyboard by reference (immutable String/Boolean, null stays null); keyboardRows → new ArrayList<>(source.keyboardRows) with explicit null guard (null stays null, not empty-list coerced). Shallow list copy is sufficient — KeyboardRow/KeyboardButton are immutable records. No field silently dropped from execution snapshot / duplicate (tech-spec Risk 1 closed).

DTO wired in BOTH directions: toSteps (780-784) and toStepDto (1419-1423) — the historically-missed toStepDto leg is present. architectural_consistency.detail: Flat immutable records, no _class (KeyboardRow/KeyboardButton mirror ContentBlock/Button precedent). One shared keyboardText/keyboardParseMode pair for both types (Decision 3). Form uses the *Touched local-reactive-array idiom (keyboardRows ref + keyboardTouched, same as menuButtons/blocks). Fire-and-forget cont() — no park, no per-subscriber keyboard state. Preview clamps echoed rows to validation caps (clampKeyboardLabels:470-498), does not re-validate. Keyword hint is client-side over active keyword funnels (containsAnyKeyword mirror, subscribeInactiveHint amber precedent — keyboardButtonHint:677-687). No v-html anywhere (8 grep hits are all comments asserting the no-v-html convention; render branch uses {{ }} only). Locale keys present in BOTH uk and en (17 keyboard* keys + 2 previewKeyboard* + type/summary labels — full parity).

not_modified_invariants.detail: git diff --stat main...dev shows TelegramSender, ProcessTelegramUpdateJob, FunnelEventService, FunnelExecutionEngine, and Mongo converters are UNCHANGED. The 23-file change set matches tech-spec scope exactly; no out-of-scope leakage. The 6-arg sendText is consumed as-is (Object replyMarkup serialized verbatim — its Javadoc says 'inline keyboard' but mechanically carries any reply_markup, so the reply keyboard works without a sender change). Task 1's temporary terminal-fail compile-fix executor cases were properly replaced by Task 3's real setKeyboard/clearKeyboard handlers — no dead intermediate code.

findings.description: The 6-arg sendText Javadoc describes replyMarkup as 'an optional inline keyboard … shaped as {"inline_keyboard":...}'. The method mechanically serializes any Object verbatim, so the SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD reply markup works correctly, but the doc no longer reflects the full set of callers.
findings.recommendation: Optional: broaden the Javadoc to 'inline OR reply keyboard markup'. No functional impact; TelegramSender is intentionally out of feature scope (Not-modified list) — leave for a future touch or skip.

findings.description: The form emits keyboardText trimmed (keyboardText.value.trim()), while backend toSteps stores dto.keyboardText() VERBATIM (untrimmed). Harmless: the form already guarantees non-blank+within-cap before emit, and the 4096 cap is checked on raw length on both sides, so a trailing-whitespace divergence cannot produce a save that passes the form but fails the backend. Noted only for completeness of the mirror.
findings.recommendation: No action — by design (the form normalizes its own emitted value; the backend keeps author text verbatim, consistent with its 'blank is a validation error not a silent normalization' policy).

findings.description: previewStep discriminates SET_KEYBOARD vs CLEAR_KEYBOARD on the SAVED step type (keyboardRows non-null only for SET_KEYBOARD). This is the documented saved-type gate (Decision 7) — a just-retyped unsaved step previews per the old saved type, identical to MESSAGE↔action behavior today. Not a regression.
findings.recommendation: No action — explicitly accepted in Decision 7 and the Risks table.
